rationale: Record that an include-hygiene change crosses three families only through their broad core/view/** and test/** selectors. core/view/include/pulp/view/widget_bridge.hpp drops an include of pulp/view/widgets.hpp that it never used, and the 16 sources that do use a widget class (core/view/src/widget_bridge.cpp, 13 core/view/src/widget_bridge/*.cpp files, test/test_design_import_codegen_layout_text.cpp and examples/pulp-delay/test_pulp_delay_ui.cpp) now include it directly. A new test TU (test/test_widget_bridge_include_fanout.cpp, registered in test/cmake/view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake) asserts the widget classes stay incomplete behind widget_bridge.hpp. No declaration, definition, behaviour, importer, DesignIR, capture path, renderer, asset, codegen output, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes; the only effect is that a widgets.hpp edit recompiles 224 translation units instead of 308. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest about a change that crossed their selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
